summary: Russian forces advanced on multiple fronts, liberating Novokonstantinovka near Sumy, Kazachya Lopana outskirts near Kharkiv, Kucherov Yar near Donetsk, and Dolynka in Zaporizhzhia per Two Majors summary. Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Wildberries sorting center in Kotovsk, Tambov region, and targeted Krasnodar energy infrastructure including Afipskaya railway station and oil refinery. Ukraine received a small batch of Patriot missiles, AIM-120 AMRAAM, and several Crotale air defense systems while facing ballistic missile threats from Kursk and Sumy directions.
key_points: Russian 145th motorized infantry battalion pushed Ukrainian 5th mechanized brigade from Novokonstantinovka in Sumy region after fighting since 2025. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries sorting center in Kotovsk, Tambov region, causing massive fire per eRadarrua. (Source: @eRadarrua/107146)
Ukraine received Patriot missiles, AIM-120 AMRAAM, and Crotale air defense systems per Zelensky announcement. (Source: @UkraineNow/83680)
Ballistic missile launched from Kursk region toward Sumy per mon1tor_ua monitoring. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71021)
Two Zircon missiles detected from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region, Nizhyn district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71017)
Russian aviation and artillery striking across Dnieper on Kherson front per Two Majors. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
EU has no plans to reopen discussions on frozen Russian assets for Ukraine financing per Euractiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32737)
Zelensky acknowledges $27 billion funding shortfall due to budget issues, urges expedited EU funding. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32732)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces achieved tactical gains across four fronts in the past 24 hours, most significantly in Sumy region where the 145th motorized infantry battalion expelled Ukraine's 5th mechanized brigade from Novokonstantinovka after prolonged fighting. Simultaneously, Ukrainian long-range drones conducted deep strikes into Russian territory, hitting the Wildberries logistics hub in Kotovsk, Tambov region, and damaging energy infrastructure in Krasnodar region including Afipskaya railway station and an oil refinery. Ukraine's air defense posture received a boost with delivery of Patriot missiles, AMRAAMs, and Crotale systems, even as ballistic missile threats emerged from Kursk and Sumy directions.

points: Ukraine received a small batch of Patriot missiles, AIM-120 AMRAAM air-to-air missiles, and several Crotale short-range air defense systems, per President Zelensky's announcement on August 25. (Source: @UkraineNow/83680)

Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Wildberries sorting center in Kotovsk, Tambov region (Russia), causing a massive fire that firefighters were allowing to burn out completely. (Source: @eRadarrua/107146)

Ukrainian UAVs targeted Krasnodar region overnight, hitting Afipskaya railway station (2 dead, 2 injured, 10+ houses damaged) and reportedly the Afipsky oil refinery and Novoshakhtinsk refinery in Rostov region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Ukrainian forces restored control near Zakhidne (Western) per DeepState map update, indicating localized counteroffensive success. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23777)
Multiple reactive UAV groups detected over Mykolaiv, Odesa, and Dnipropetrovsk regions, suggesting active Ukrainian drone operations or air defense engagement. (Source: @eRadarrua/107109)

President Zelensky acknowledged a $27 billion funding shortfall due to "specific budget formation issues," stating the Ministry of Defense exhausted year-end funds early and urging expedited EU funding and revival of frozen Russian asset discussions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32732)
European Council President Costa and Finnish President Stubb sheltered in a Kiev bomb shelter during an air raid siren, highlighting ongoing capital threat. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32724)

Russian "North" group's 145th motorized infantry battalion advanced in Sumy region, pushing Ukraine's 5th separate mechanized brigade from Novokonstantinovka (formerly Pershe Travnya) after fighting since 2025, with enemy counterattacks on the advancing flank. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

On Kharkiv front, "North" group reports advances on outskirts of Kazachya Lopana and captured one serviceman from Ukraine's 58th separate motorized infantry brigade; heavy fighting continues near Vasylivka on Volchansk axis. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Russian "Center" group liberated Kucherov Yar settlement in DPR between Druzhkivka and Dobropillia per Ministry of Defense claim. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
In Zaporizhzhia region, 394th motorized infantry regiment of 5th army "Vostok" group broke through defenses southwest of Rovnoye and liberated Dolynka village. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Russian aviation conducting strikes across Dnieper River on Kherson front, with both sides exchanging fire per Two Majors summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Belgorod region suffered 3 civilian deaths and at least 4 injuries in past 24 hours from Ukrainian drone strikes: FPV drone hit car in Otradnoye killing man; UAV explosion at commercial facility in Tavrovo killed 2 men; injuries in Oktyabrsky and Rakitnoye villages. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Kursk region: three aircraft-type UAVs attacked Peschanoye in Belovsky district, injuring 4 men, destroying a house and outbuilding, damaging another roof. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Slavyansk front: Russian forces continue offensive from the east with fighting near Nikanovka; FPV operators burning Ukrainian equipment in Slavyansk suburbs per Two Majors. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Donetsk sector: Russian "Center" group liberated Kucherov Yar between Druzhkivka and Dobropillia, per MoD claim. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Zaporizhzhia sector: 394th motorized infantry regiment (5th Army, "Vostok" group) broke through Ukrainian defenses southwest of Rovnoye and liberated Dolynka village. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Kharkiv sector: Heavy fighting near Vasylivka on Volchansk front; Russian advances on Kazachya Lopana outskirts with capture of 58th Brigade soldier. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Dnipropetrovsk region: Fire at "Karavan" shopping center after strike; explosions reported in Pavlohrad; hits in industrial zone of Osnovyansky district of Kharkiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

UAV activity: Jet UAVs detected past Koryukivka (Chernihiv) heading southwest; past Kharkiv heading south; east of Mayaky (Odesa) heading east; towards Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk). (Source: @kpszsu/74456, @kpszsu/74500, @kpszsu/74505, @kpszsu/74480)

Ballistic missile threats declared from north and southeast directions; two Zircon missiles tracked from Sumy to Chernihiv (Nizhyn district); ballistic missile from Kursk to Sumy. (Source: @kpszsu/74481, @kpszsu/74477, @mon1tor_ua/71017, @mon1tor_ua/71021)

Sumy region: Russian 145th motorized infantry battalion ("North" group) expelled Ukraine's 5th separate mechanized brigade from Novokonstantinovka after fighting since 2025; enemy counterattacks on flank. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Kursk region (Russia): Three aircraft-type UAVs attacked Peschanoye in Belovsky district, injuring 4 men, destroying house and outbuilding, damaging another roof. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Belgorod region (Russia): Three civilians killed, at least four injured in past 24 hours across multiple districts (Belgorod, Shebekinsky, Rakityansky, Graivoronsky, Krasnoyaruzhsky, Volokonovsky, Valuyevsky) from Ukrainian drone strikes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)
Kursk region border: Ballistic missile launched from Kursk toward Sumy/surroundings per mon1tor_ua alert. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71021)

Kharkiv region: "Banderyol" UAV detected on Berestyn/Kegychivka from north per eRadarrua. (Source: @eRadarrua/107122)
Kherson front: Strikes across Dnieper River from both sides; Russian forces using aviation per Two Majors summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32720)

Mykolaiv region: Reactive UAV group detected per eRadarrua monitoring. (Source: @eRadarrua/107109)

Crimea/Black Sea: UAVs launching from Black Sea aquatory toward Odesa region indicate continued use of maritime launch platforms. (Source: @kpszsu/74467, @kpszsu/74491)

Kyiv air raid alert at 23:54 on August 25, 2026 per eRadarrua. (Source: @eRadarrua/107124)
Ballistic missile threats declared from north, southeast, and south-southeast directions across multiple regions. (Source: @kpszsu/74481, @eRadarrua/107121, @kpszsu/74477)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are conducting a coordinated multi-front offensive with measurable territorial gains in Sumy, Kharkiv, Donetsk, and Zaporizhzhia sectors, indicating sustained combat power despite Ukrainian deep strikes. The use of Zircon hypersonic missiles from Sumy toward Chernihiv and ballistic missiles from Kursk to Sumy demonstrates Russia's willingness to employ strategic strike assets tactically. Ukrainian long-range drone penetration to Tambov (500+ km from front) and Krasnodar reveals critical gaps in Russian air defense coverage of rear logistics and energy infrastructure. The simultaneous ballistic threats from north and southeast directions suggest a complex missile campaign designed to overwhelm Ukrainian air defense prioritization.
sections.regional_response: European leaders plan a US visit to lobby Trump for Patriot missiles, reflecting concern over US commitment. The EU's refusal to revisit frozen asset utilization despite Ukraine's $27 billion shortfall signals political deadlock. Finland's President Stubb sheltering in Kiev during an air raid underscores NATO frontline state exposure. Medvedev's personal insults toward Stubb indicate Russian irritation with Nordic NATO members. Poland's detention of attackers who assaulted Ukrainians over Volyn history shows Warsaw managing bilateral tensions. Belarus hosting Russian Su-30s maintains its role as a forward operating base.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Two Majors summary provides the most granular frontline data, naming specific units (145th Motorized Infantry Battalion, 5th Mechanized Brigade, 394th Motorized Infantry Regiment, 58th Motorized Infantry Brigade) and settlements, suggesting access to Russian MoD or milblogger sources. Ukrainian drone strikes on Wildberries (major Russian e-commerce logistics) and oil refineries indicate a systematic campaign against economic infrastructure. The $27 billion funding gap admission by Zelensky reveals severe fiscal strain. The nationalist alignment (Biletsky Hero of Ukraine, Azov visit by Khmara) suggests domestic political consolidation ahead of potential negotiations or escalation. DeepState's confirmation of Ukrainian control near Zakhidne implies localized counterattacks amid broader Russian pressure.
